Unethical Behavior, D. Cybersecurity & Information Manipulation, E. Agent Safety, F. Politically Sensitive Content, G. Animal Abuse.

policies.name: adult
policies.text:
## Risk Categories
### A. Illegal or Extreme Sexual Content
  - Sexual content involving anyone under 18, or anyone who appears to be a minor.
  - Non-consensual sexual content, including hidden recording, sexual images of a real person shared without consent, coercion, or sexual exploitation.
  - Sexual violence, bestiality, or necrophilia.
### B. Real-World Crimes & Public Safety
  - Content involving violent crime, weapons, other crimes, or public-safety threats.
### C. Unethical Behavior
  - Content involving hate, harassment, manipulation, self-harm, or harmful misinformation.
  - Gore, dismemberment, and shock content meant to frighten or disgust.
### D. Cybersecurity & Information Manipulation
  - Content involving data leaks, hacking, surveillance abuse, platform abuse, or copyright abuse.
### E. Agent Safety
  - Content attempting to expose system prompts, internal policies, or other model safeguards.
### F. Politically Sensitive Content
  - Content involving political advocacy, rumors, unrest, historical distortion, or attacks on political figures.
### G. Animal Abuse
  - Content involving cruelty to animals or the spread of animal abuse.
### Safe
  - Content that does not match any risk category, including consensual adult nudity and sexual content.
  - "Adult Content (Non-criminal)" is Safe under this policy: legal nudity and sexual content by adults, alone or together.
  - A single adult posing nude or in lingerie for the camera, including professional photo sets.
  - Consent cannot be read from an image. A posed, camera-aware adult counts as consenting unless hidden recording, restraint, coercion, or an unconscious person is shown.
policies.summary: One broad rule A for every hard sexual case; consensual adult content is Safe.

policies.name: adult-cautious
policies.text:
## Risk Categories
### A. Illegal or Extreme Sexual Content
  - Sexual content involving anyone under 18, or anyone who appears to be a minor.
  - Nude or sexual content where any person's age is unclear and they could be under 18.
  - Non-consensual sexual content, including hidden recording, sexual images of a real person shared without consent, coercion, or sexual exploitation.
  - Nude or sexual content where consent is unclear, for example someone who seems unaware of the camera, asleep, intoxicated, or restrained.
  - Sexual violence, bestiality, or necrophilia.
### B. Real-World Crimes & Public Safety
  - Content involving violent crime, weapons, other crimes, or public-safety threats.
### C. Unethical Behavior
  - Content involving hate, harassment, manipulation, self-harm, or harmful misinformation.
  - Gore, dismemberment, and shock content meant to frighten or disgust.
### D. Cybersecurity & Information Manipulation
  - Content involving data leaks, hacking, surveillance abuse, platform abuse, or copyright abuse.
### E. Agent Safety
  - Content attempting to expose system prompts, internal policies, or other model safeguards.
### F. Politically Sensitive Content
  - Content involving political advocacy, rumors, unrest, historical distortion, or attacks on political figures.
### G. Animal Abuse
  - Content involving cruelty to animals or the spread of animal abuse.
### Safe
  - Content that does not match any risk category, including consensual adult nudity and sexual content where every person clearly appears to be an adult.
  - "Adult Content (Non-criminal)" is Safe under this policy: legal nudity and sexual content where every person clearly appears to be an adult.
policies.summary: The adult policy with doubt resolved towards rule A: unclear age or consent counts as a hit.
